I couldn't confirm the last Saturday train, so please don't treat any time below as settled.

- **Last train:** I found no official LNER source that gives the last Saturday departure from Edinburgh. The only figures I saw came from third-party sites, and those conflict. One suggests a 19:00 departure arriving at 23:55, and another suggests 20:20. Neither is clearly Saturday-specific. I'd trust neither of them over LNER itself. Your 17:30 cutoff looks too early, but I can't prove that either way.
- **Journey time:** Direct trains take roughly 4h20 to 4h45. The 19:00 to 23:55 entry would be about 4h55, which suggests a slower evening service.
- **Which dates the timetable covers:** It isn't a single all-year timetable. LNER publishes two guides: 17 May to 12 December 2026, and 13 December 2026 to 15 May 2027. Saturday times can differ between them. Engineering works and bank holidays can also change individual Saturdays.
- **Why your site may stop at 17:30:** Booking usually opens only about 12 weeks ahead. Later trains may exist but not yet be bookable, or may be affected by engineering works.

To settle it, open the LNER timetable PDF that covers your travel date and read the Edinburgh to King's Cross Saturday page. You can also check National Rail Enquiries for that exact date. If you can tell me the date, I can try again.

Sources: LNER timetables page (lner.co.uk/travel-information/timetables), live-departures.info and busmaps.com. I couldn't open the LNER PDFs themselves.
